 사진 확대 MINO of SHINee. Photo by STAR TODAY DB, SNS Amid controversy over group SHINee Minho's physical assistance from pacemakers in the marathon, complaints have been raised to confirm the appropriateness of maintaining the appointment of a public relations ambassador for the Korea Sports Association.
 On the 4th, A, a civil petitioner, posted on the online community that he submitted a related report to the Korean Sports Council through a national newspaper.
 A questioned the scene of Min-ho running with the help of a pacemaker at the "2026 JTBC Seoul Marathon" held on the 1st, and how Min-ho, who is known to have challenged the first full-course marathon, was assigned to Group B.
 In the report, A checked whether the physical contact constitutes a violation of the game regulations and asked Minho to reveal how he was assigned to the starting group. He also asked to consider whether it is appropriate to maintain the qualifications of the Korean Sports Association as a public relations ambassador.
 사진 확대 MINO of SHINee. Photo by Star Today DB Earlier on the 1st, Minho participated in the "2026 JTBC Seoul Marathon" and completed the 42.195-km full course in 3 hours and 18 seconds. However, since then, a video showing a pacemaker running together seems to be pushing Minho's back has spread online, sparking controversy.
 In response, Minho said on his social network service (SNS) on the 3rd, "I'm sorry for disappointing many people at the marathon," adding, "Everything happened because of my lack, and I'm ashamed of myself as a person who cares and loves sports." Once again, I'm sorry for the concern I've caused you," he said.
